groups.note: I was thinking of writing a blog article on this, but there are people talking about one-shot "uber prompts" to create simulations/demos/games (see also: r/aigamedev). I tried it out myself over ~10h of autonomous Codex, and it does an incredible job of a lot of features at very low quality. Very impressive in a way, but also extremely funny how much throwaway work it does (because it auto-critics itself constantly, it often redoes a lot of work, especially on graphics).
